steps.title: Customer designs
steps.description: They describe the idea, pick fabrics, or upload reference photos in the bespoke studio.

steps.title: AI renders it
steps.description: The studio generates outfit visuals in seconds, so the idea is agreed on before any work starts.

steps.title: You get the brief
steps.description: The design lands with you as a quote request—visuals, styles, fabric, measurements, and notes.

steps.title: Quote & craft
steps.description: Send your price and timeline. When the customer picks you, production starts with zero ambiguity.
